items.reason: A gentle-strength, once-nightly gel that suits a teen who wants to keep chin and jaw spots looking clearer.
A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that cleans without stripping or adding to dryness.
A light ceramide moisturizer to keep skin comfortable and support the barrier while using the gel.
A mineral SPF 50 for every morning, since the gel can make skin more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: Start by using a pea-sized amount of the gel on dry skin 2 to 3 nights a week, then moisturize, and build up only if skin stays comfortable. Wear SPF every morning, and if the spots feel painful or stay stubborn, a dermatologist can help with more than a shop can offer.
